sentences.zh: （案：以上〔所載十道、州、府、軍、縣，當是以《開元十道圖》為本，而於五代之改制，及仍唐舊制者則闕焉。

translations.literal: (Note: The ten circuits, prefectures, superior prefectures, armies, and counties recorded above were presumably based on the 《Atlas of the Ten Circuits of the Kaiyuan Era》, but reforms of the Five Dynasties period and places that retained Tang institutions are omitted.
translations.idiomatic: (Note: The ten circuits and their prefectures, superior prefectures, armies, and counties listed above appear to follow the 《Kaiyuan Atlas of the Ten Circuits》, but Five Dynasties reforms and jurisdictions that kept Tang arrangements are missing.

translations.idiomatic: The original may have been shortened;] it is retained here at the opening of the chapter to preserve the older record.)

sentences.zh: 後唐長興三年四月，中書門下奏：「據《十道圖》，舊制以王者所都之地為上，本朝都長安，遂以關內道為上。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Changxing of Later Tang, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "According to the 《Atlas of the Ten Circuits》, the old regulation ranked first the place where the king established his capital; our dynasty's capital was at Chang'an, and therefore the Guannei Circuit was ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of Changxing, Later Tang, the Secretariat-Chancellery submitted: "Under the 《Atlas of the Ten Circuits》, the capital region ranked first; when our court was at Chang'an, the Guannei Circuit held that place.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟宮闕皆在洛陽，請以河南道為上，關內道為二，河東道第三，河北道第四，劍南道第五，江南道第六，淮南道第七，山南道第八，隴右道第九，嶺南道第十。

translations.literal: Now the ancestral temples and palace halls are all at Luoyang; we request that the Henan Circuit be ranked first, the Guannei Circuit second, the Hedong Circuit third, the Hebei Circuit fourth, the Jiannan Circuit fifth, the Jiangnan Circuit sixth, the Huainan Circuit seventh, the Shannan Circuit eighth, the Longyou Circuit ninth, and the Lingnan Circuit tenth."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the ancestral temples and palaces are at Luoyang, we ask that Henan Circuit rank first, Guannei second, Hedong third, Hebei fourth, Jiannan fifth, Jiangnan sixth, Huainan seventh, Shannan eighth, Longyou ninth, and Lingnan tenth."

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: （後唐長興三年二月，秦州奏：「見管長道、成紀、清水三縣外，有十鎮，征科並系鎮將。

translations.literal: (In the second month of the third year of Changxing of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture memorialized: "Beyond the three counties of Changdao, Chengji, and Qingshui presently administered, there are ten garrisons, and levies are all handled by the garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: (In the second month of Changxing 3, Qin Prefecture reported: "Besides the three counties now administered—Changdao, Chengji, and Qingshui—there are ten garrisons whose tax levies are all handled by garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 今請以歸化、恕水、五龍、黃土四鎮就歸化鎮復置舊隴城縣，赤砂、染坊、夕陽、南冶、鐵務五鎮就赤砂鎮復置舊天水縣。

translations.literal: We now request that the four garrisons of Guihua, Shushui, Wulong, and Huangtu, based on Guihua Garrison, restore the former Longcheng County; the five garrisons of Chisha, Ranfang, Xiyang, Nanye, and Tiewu, based on Chisha Garrison, restore the former Tianshui County.
translations.idiomatic: We ask to restore former Longcheng County from the four garrisons of Guihua, Shushui, Wulong, and Huangtu centered on Guihua Garrison, and former Tianshui County from the five garrisons of Chisha, Ranfang, Xiyang, Nanye, and Tiewu centered on Chisha Garrison.

sentences.zh: 其白石、大澤、良恭三鎮割屬長道縣。

translations.literal: The three garrisons of Baishi, Daze, and Liangong are cut off and assigned to Changdao County.
translations.idiomatic: The three garrisons of Baishi, Daze, and Liangong would be reassigned to Changdao County.

translations.literal: " The request was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.)

translations.literal: Tonggu County and Liting County of Cheng Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Tonggu and Liting counties, Cheng Prefecture

translations.literal: The edition prints a left angle bracket opening an editorial gloss.

sentences.zh: （後唐清泰三年六月，秦州奏：「階州元管將利、福津兩縣，並無遷鎮，成州元管同谷縣，餘並是鎮，便系征科。

translations.literal: (In the sixth month of the third year of Qingtai of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture memorialized: "Jie Prefecture originally administered Jiangli and Fujin counties, and had no relocated garrisons; Cheng Prefecture originally administered Tonggu County, while the rest were all garrisons whose levies were handled [by them].
translations.idiomatic: (In the sixth month of Qingtai 3, Qin Prefecture reported: "Jie Prefecture originally had Jiangli and Fujin counties and no relocated garrisons; Cheng Prefecture had only Tonggu County, while the rest were garrisons whose levies were collected directly.

sentences.zh: 今欲取成州西南近便鎮分並入同谷縣，其東界四鎮，別創一縣者，州西南有府城、長豐、魏平三鎮，其地東至泥陽鎮界二十五里，北至黃竹路金砂鎮界五十里，南至興州界三十里，西至白石鎮界一百一十里，西南至舊階州界砂地嶺四十五里。

translations.literal: We now wish to take convenient garrisons in the southwest of Cheng Prefecture and merge them into Tonggu County; as for the four garrisons on the eastern border, for which a separate county is to be created—in the southwest of the prefecture are Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping garrisons; its territory extends east to the border of Niyang Garrison twenty-five li, north to the border of Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road fifty li, south to the border of Xing Prefecture thirty li, west to the border of Baishi Garrison one hundred ten li, and southwest to Shadi Ridge on the border of old Jie Prefecture forty-five li.
translations.idiomatic: We wish to merge convenient southwestern garrisons into Tonggu County and, for the four eastern garrisons, create a new county: in the prefecture's southwest are Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping garrisons, bounded east by Niyang Garrison at twenty-five li, north by Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road at fifty li, south by Xing Prefecture at thirty li, west by Baishi Garrison at one hundred ten li, and southwest by Shadi Ridge on the old Jie border at forty-five li.

sentences.zh: 其三鎮管界並入同谷縣，廢其鎮額。

translations.literal: The jurisdictions of these three garrisons are all merged into Tonggu County, and their garrison designations are abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Those three garrisons' jurisdictions would merge into Tonggu County and their garrison designations be abolished.

sentences.zh: 州東界有勝仙、泥陽、金砂、栗亭四鎮，東至鳳州美贍鎮界十五里，南至果州界二十里，北至高橋三十五里，西至同谷界三十五里，北至秦州界六十七里，欲並其四鎮地於栗亭縣。

translations.literal: On the eastern border of the prefecture are the four garrisons of Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting; east to the border of Meishan Garrison of Feng Prefecture fifteen li, south to the border of Guo Prefecture twenty li, north to Gaoqiao thirty-five li, west to the border of Tonggu thirty-five li, north to the border of Qin Prefecture sixty-seven li; we wish to merge the territories of all four garrisons into Liting County.
translations.idiomatic: On the east are Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting garrisons, bounded east by Meishan Garrison in Feng Prefecture at fifteen li, south by Guo Prefecture at twenty li, north by Gaoqiao at thirty-five li, west by Tonggu at thirty-five li, and north by Qin Prefecture at sixty-seven li; we wish to merge all four garrisons' territories into Liting County.

sentences.zh: 其征科委縣司，捕盜委鎮司。

translations.literal: Levies are entrusted to the county office; apprehension of bandits is entrusted to the garrison office.
translations.idiomatic: Tax collection would fall to the county office and bandit suppression to the garrison office.

translations.literal: " The request was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.)

translations.literal: (In the third month of the third year of Kaiyun of Jin, Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to a prefecture; Quanyi County was also changed to Dechang County, and Linchuan, Guangming, Yining, and three other counties of Gui Prefecture were cut off and assigned to it, following the memorial of Ma Xifan of Hunan.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (In the third month of Kaiyun 3, Later Jin elevated Quanyi in Gui Prefecture to prefectural status, renamed Quanyi to Dechang, reassigned Linchuan, Guangming, Yining, and three other Gui counties to it, as Ma Xifan of Hunan had memorialized.)
